'''Lancelot Stephen Bosanquet''' (26 December 1903 St. Stephen's-by-Saltash, Cornwall, England – 10 January 1984 Cambridge) was a British mathematician who worked in [[analysis (mathematics)|analysis]], especially [[Fourier series]].

His daughter, [[Caroline Bosanquet|Rosamund Caroline Bosanquet]] (1940–2013) was a British cellist, music teacher and composer.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www-history.mcs.st-and.ac.uk/Biographies/Bosanquet.html|title=Bosanquet biography|website=www-history.mcs.st-and.ac.uk|access-date=2018-09-02}}</ref>
